rust_summary: a line in the server's log at a level (`native_log`), in the console's format on a dedicated server.
doc_summary: `native_log(level, line)` writes a line to the server's log at `INFO`, `WARN` or `ERROR`, in the console's format on a dedicated server, as the server writes its own lines. Bundles need no hook; the helper is `Host::log`. API @API:server_log@.
